name: Anti-Ragging Committee
head: Dean / Designated Senior Faculty
description: Enforces zero-tolerance anti-ragging regulations, conducts surprise inspections in student hostels, and maintains anti-ragging undertakings from students and parents.

name: Curriculum Committee
head: Professor & Academic In-charge
description: Monitors implementation of NMC's Competency-Based Medical Education (CBME) timetable, early clinical exposure (ECE), and internal assessment schedules.

name: Internal Complaints Committee (ICC)
head: Presiding Female Faculty Officer
description: Mandatory committee under POSH Act ensuring a safe and dignified workplace and academic environment for female students, medical staff, and employees.

name: Student Grievance Redressal Committee
head: Senior Faculty Advisory Board
description: Addresses student grievances concerning academic evaluations, hostel infrastructure, mess facilities, and campus life.

name: Pharmacovigilance Committee
head: Professor & HOD (Pharmacology)
description: Monitors, documents, and reports Adverse Drug Reactions (ADRs) occurring within inpatient wards and OPD units to the National Pharmacovigilance Program.

name: Institutional Ethics Committee (IEC)
head: Independent Ethics Chairperson
description: Evaluates and approves research proposals, clinical trials, and ICMR STS projects for human subject ethics compliance.

name: Medical Education Unit (MEU)
head: MEU Coordinator / Dean
description: Conducts faculty development workshops, revised basic course workshops in medical education, and teaching pedagogy training.

name: Research Advisory Committee
head: Research Board Convener
description: Encourages scientific publications, guides postgraduate thesis work, and facilitates institutional research grants.

name: Student Manas Scheme Committee
head: Counseling Cell In-charge
description: Provides psychological counseling, peer mentorship, and wellness guidance to help medical students adapt to rigorous academic environments.

name: Student Mental Stress Relief Committee
head: Department of Psychiatry
description: Organizes stress management workshops, mindfulness sessions, and 24/7 mental health helpline support for resident doctors and MBBS students.
